kv17.6:0.4: 17. 6. na vattabbaṃ saṅgho dakkhiṇaṃ patigaṇhātīti kathā.
kv17.6:1.4: nanu saṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti.
kv17.6:1.6: hañci saṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv17.6:2.4: nanu cattāro purisayugā aṭṭhapurisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā bhagavatāti.
kv17.6:2.6: hañci cattāro purisayugā aṭṭhapurisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā bhagavatā. tena vata re vattabbe:
kv17.6:3.4: nanu atthi keci saṅghassa dānaṃ dentīti.
kv17.6:3.6: hañci atthi keci saṅghassa dakkhiṇaṃ denti. tena vata re vattabbe:
kv17.6:3.8: nanu atthi keci saṅghassa cīvaraṃ denti …pe…
kv17.6:3.16: hañci atthi keci saṅghassa pānīyaṃ dentī, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv17.6:7.5: na vattabbaṃ saṅgho dakkhiṇaṃ patigaṇhātīti kathā niṭṭhitā.
